name: Braço do Trombudo (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Braço do Trombudo is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 28 of 22 April 1993: green for the forest and vegetation, white for peace and prosperity and yellow for the municipality's resources.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a cogwheel, a landscape and a bird, over a scroll reading Braço do Trombudo 1993
